verdicts.strongest_argument: Both halves are published, and the more important half was published BY MANAGEMENT into a 28.6% down day. Deng's exact memory-cost warning is in the Q1 transcript (fool.com, 2026-06-10) and in the Q1 press release ('elevated memory component costs... DDR4 to DDR5'), and ZEPP fell 28.64% on the 2026-06-09 print -- the margin-under-memory-pressure narrative is the single most recently repriced fact on this name. The escalation half is not obscure either: the 2025-26 memory squeeze has its own Wikipedia article, CNBC (2026-01-10), The Register (2026-02-02) and Tom's Hardware coverage of Q3 2026 pricing, plus Apple raising hardware prices on 2026-06-25 and Cisco flagging ~200bps of margin erosion. The specific TrendForce DDR2 datapoint was syndicated to EE Times Asia, TechPowerUp and VideoCardz on/after 2026-06-22, i.e. eight days before the quarter being reported even closed. Two further deductions: the +35-40% figure is a 3Q26 contract price and therefore cannot sit in an Apr-Jun cost of goods sold at all (the Q2-relevant number is the +55-60% already in the same TrendForce release), and TrendForce's own follow-up (2026-07-03) says 3Q26 gains moderate as consumer demand weakens. What is left unpriced is narrow: that legacy-node substitution (DDR4->DDR3->DDR2) is precisely the memory tier a wearable uses, so Zepp's exposure is worse than the generic 'DDR5 transition' framing management gave. That residual is real but small against a memory BOM of a few hundred megabytes per watch.

verdicts.strongest_argument: The factual premise is contested by the company's own primary document. Zepp's Business Wire release of 2026-06-02 states Balance Ultra and Balance 3 Stainless Steel are 'available starting June 2, 2026' at $599.99/$369.99 with Balance 3 Titanium 'coming soon' at $449.99, and secondary coverage records pre-orders from June 2 with shipping mid-June. The5krunner's 'turn of June and July' is one niche blog's reading, explicitly caveated for European variation, and it is the only support the claim has. Even taking the blog at face value, the conclusion is structural rather than discovered: a flagship announced 2026-06-02 into a quarter closing 2026-06-30 obviously contributes little, and management set the $63-68m Q2 revenue guide on 2026-06-08 with full knowledge of the actual ship dates -- so any Q2 shortfall from launch timing is inside the guide, not outside it. The forward half (Q3 first quarter with two $599.99 SKUs, ASPs +20% YoY, no discounting) is the bull case management itself made on the June call and the5krunner already published on 2026-06-09; what it lacks is not publication but conviction, which is exactly why the stock is 91.8% off its high. The only genuinely unpriced element is whether the 1 September Q3 revenue guide comes in above the mechanical seasonal step-up, and that is an outcome, not a finding.

verdicts.strongest_argument: The event is real and I verified it, but it has been reported at three levels of visibility across seven weeks, the top one being Bloomberg Law. Bloomberg Law carried 'Zepp Drops Patent Suit Against Oura Over Fitness Tracking Tech' off the 2026-07-10 dismissal notice; the ITC issued its determination not to review on 2026-08-11 and published the notice 2026-08-12, which is a public docket entry; and gadgetsandwearables laid the whole thing out including the joint 2026-07-09 motion and the settlement basis on 2026-08-21, ten days before the print. The hunter is correct that no 6-K was filed -- EDGAR shows exactly two 6-Ks in 2026, 2026-03-16 and 2026-06-09 -- and that is the one thing that keeps this below 70, because an ADR holder who reads only filings would not know. Against that: the mechanism does not reach this print. The termination is dated July, so any settlement or royalty charge falls in Q3, and the exclusion-order risk being removed attached to the Helio Ring, a minor SKU inside a $63-68m revenue quarter for which the ITC had issued no remedy and set no target date that would have bitten inside 2026. Removing an unquantified tail on a product line the market has never valued separately is worth low single digits at most, and the 20-day tape is +12.98% through the window in which the ITC notice published.

verdicts.strongest_argument: Every input to this 'reconstruction' is printed by the company in its own quarterly press releases, so there is nothing to reconstruct. The cumulative amount used appears each quarter: $16.0m at 2025-06-30, $16.1m at 2025-09-30, $16.2m at 2025-12-31, and $17.0m at 2026-03-31 (the last stated on the Q1 call). The arithmetic also flips the story: because the disclosure is quarterly, ~$0.8m of the ~$1.0m of buying the hunter spreads across nine months in fact occurred inside Q1 2026 alone -- the program was near-frozen through H2 2025 and then accelerated eightfold into the drawdown. 'Effectively dormant' is a defensible read of the nine-month total but a wrong read of the trajectory, and the trajectory is what a marginal holder would care about. On size, the remaining capacity is $3m against a ~$73m market cap and expires November 2026; even full and immediate exhaustion is roughly 4% of cap bought at 38,000 ADS/day, which is a liquidity constraint, not a signal. Shares outstanding down only 1.66% YoY and $103.2m of cash are both disclosed figures in the same documents.

verdicts.strongest_argument: This is a filing that was headlined by a filings aggregator the day it hit -- StockTitan ran 'Zepp Health holder Point72 reports 0% ownership' on the 2026-08-14 13G/A, and StreetInsider carried the companion Morgan Stanley 13G/A -- so it is wire-level published, not obscure. More decisively, a 13G/A is a backward-looking snapshot: the reported position is 0.00 as of 2026-06-30, meaning the selling was already through a tape averaging ~38,000 ADS a day at some point on or before the end of Q2, and the price has since risen 12.98% over 20 days with no visible adverse reaction to the 14 August filing itself. There is no forward supply left to fear because the position is already zero. The Morgan Stanley 8.8% observation actively weakens the claim rather than strengthening it: shared voting and dispositive power at a broker-dealer with 11,869,344 shares as of 2026-06-30, up from 7.5% at 2025-09-30, is a custody/swap footprint that tells you nothing about fundamental conviction in either direction, and treating it as evidence of an absentee shareholder base is an interpretation, not a fact. A go-to-zero 13G/A on a ~$73m ADR with no analyst coverage is close to information-free.

adversary_notes: Three factual corrections. (1) ZEPP-h1#1's premise is contradicted by Zepp's own launch release: Business Wire 2026-06-02 says Balance Ultra ($599.99) and Balance 3 Stainless Steel ($369.99) are 'available starting June 2, 2026', with only Balance 3 Titanium 'coming soon'; secondary coverage records shipping mid-June. The5krunner's 'turn of June and July' is a single blog with an explicit European-variation caveat. Balance Ultra therefore almost certainly does sit in the Apr-Jun quarter for roughly four weeks, and the hunter's 'essentially none of the new flagship line' is likely wrong. (2) ZEPP-h1#3's nine-month framing is arithmetically true but materially misleading. The intermediate quarterly disclosures ($16.1m at 2025-09-30, $16.2m at 2025-12-31) show the program was near-frozen through H2 2025 and then bought ~$0.8m in Q1 2026 alone -- buying accelerated into the drawdown rather than remaining dormant. Every figure is in a company press release, so no reconstruction was required. (3) ZEPP-h1#0 mixes quarters. The Apr-Jun quarter being reported corresponds to the +55-60% 2Q26 DDR2 move in the same TrendForce release; the +35-40% is a 3Q26 contract price and cannot appear in this print's cost of goods sold, only in H2 commentary. TrendForce's own 2026-07-03 update says 3Q26 memory gains moderate. Separately, both #0 and #3 rest on the same Q1 transcript, and the headline element of #0 -- memory as the named gross-margin risk -- was disclosed by management on the day the stock fell 28.64%, which is the strongest single fact in this brief and it cuts against the hunter. On the name as a whole: with no usable option chain, no EPS consensus and a median absolute reaction of 15.97%, there is no readable statement of what the market priced, so my numbers lean on publication dates and the 2026-06-09 reaction rather than on skew. The best-surviving finding is #2 (ITC termination): verified in the docket, absent from any 6-K, and genuinely not in front of a filings-only holder -- but it is in Bloomberg Law and its P&L effect lands in Q3, not this print. Note also that a real consensus does exist despite the missing EPS estimate: Zepp guided Q2 revenue to $63-68m on 2026-06-08, so revenue surprise here is measurable even where EPS surprise is not.
interactions: ZEPP-h1#0 and ZEPP-h1#3 both rest on the same Q1 2026 call transcript. ZEPP-h1#1 and ZEPP-h1#2 both have their P&L effect in Q3 rather than in the quarter being reported. ZEPP-h1#1 is contradicted by Zepp's own 2026-06-02 launch release.
